survey: A gold three-arm candelabra on a plain purple sunburst background, with no ground plane drawn. A domed round base sits at the bottom. A turned central stem with knop and collar rings rises from it. Two U-shaped arms curve out from a central knop, one to each side, and rise to drip-pan cups. A taller central cup sits on top of the stem. Three cream candles with lit flames stand upright in the cups. The camera is slightly above the object and faces it from the front. The base shows the widest ellipse, its top seen from above. The stem collars and drip pans higher up show narrower ellipses, and the candle tops are almost edge-on. This is the correct steady narrowing for one eye level near the top of the object. The arms lie in a plane facing the camera and are symmetric. The stem and candles are vertical and parallel, and each candle sits squarely in its cup. The base rests flat with a soft shadow under it, which matches its ellipse.
